title.narrative: Support activities for the conservation of natural World Heritage

description.narrative: The World Heritage Convention is a key international instrument for biodiversity conservation and climate action. Leveraging its unique role, the World Heritage Centre supports States Parties and other stakeholders in advancing biodiversity conservation, climate change mitigation and adaptation, and efforts to address the triple planetary crisis in World Heritage properties through state of conservation monitoring, technical assistance, capacity-building, and targeted support in response to emerging threats.
